  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,

}

      } finally {

      }
    }
  };
}

import type { ArcRotateCamera, SceneContext } from "@babylonjs/lite";
import { attachControl, setCameraLimits } from "@babylonjs/lite";

export function attachLimitedOrbit(
  camera: ArcRotateCamera,
  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
  scene: SceneContext,
  minDistance: number,
  maxDistance: number,
): () => void {
  // Accept swapped bounds defensively; radius is still constrained to the interval.
  const lowerRadiusLimit = Math.min(minDistance, maxDistance);
  const upperRadiusLimit = Math.max(minDistance, maxDistance);

  const savedLowerRadiusLimit = camera.lowerRadiusLimit;
  const savedUpperRadiusLimit = camera.upperRadiusLimit;

  const restoreRadiusLimits = () => {
    if (savedLowerRadiusLimit === undefined) {
      delete camera.lowerRadiusLimit;
    } else {
      camera.lowerRadiusLimit = savedLowerRadiusLimit;
    }

    if (savedUpperRadiusLimit === undefined) {
      delete camera.upperRadiusLimit;
    } else {
      camera.upperRadiusLimit = savedUpperRadiusLimit;
    }
  };

  // The library controls themselves only add inertial offsets; attachControl needs
  // scene so those offsets are applied each frame. Keyboard controls are disabled
  // so the returned dispose leaves no canvas key listeners.
  const disposeControls = attachControl(camera, canvas, scene, { keyboard: false });

  // setCameraLimits clamps every radius write (wheel, pinch, direct writes) and zeroes
  // inertialRadiusOffset when a bound is hit. Calling it after attachControl keeps it
  // as the latest limits installer if the controls install their own beta defaults.
  let disposeRadiusLimits: () => void = () => {};
  try {
    disposeRadiusLimits = setCameraLimits(
      camera,
      { lowerRadiusLimit, upperRadiusLimit },
      scene,
    );
  } catch (error) {
    try {
      disposeControls();
    } catch {
      // If control cleanup fails, still try to restore the limits.
    }
    restoreRadiusLimits();
    throw error;
  }

  let disposed = false;
  return () => {
    if (disposed) return;
    disposed = true;

    try {
      disposeControls();
    } finally {
      try {
        disposeRadiusLimits();
      } finally {
        restoreRadiusLimits();
      }
    }
  };
}
